items.title: Opus 5.5 token and judgment change report, 1 October
items.claim: One author reports a rise in median thinking tokens per request from 67 to 126 and output tokens from 447 to 711 between 29 earlier Opus 5.5 High sessions and 8 sessions on 1 October. Claude Code CLI version changed on the comparison date; tasks were not matched, and no independent quality result is available.

items.title: OpenAI Dot turn errors in Codex and Work
items.claim: OpenAI marked the 7 October incident resolved after reporting Dot turn failures, delayed responses, and reduced proactivity.

items.title: OpenAI APAC errors in ChatGPT Work, conversations, and GPTs
items.claim: OpenAI marked the incident resolved at 04:51 UTC on 8 October after reporting errors for some APAC users.

items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Instant errors in FedRAMP workspaces
items.claim: OpenAI marked the incident resolved at 00:03 UTC on 8 October after applying mitigation.

items.title: LiveNerf progress as of 8 October
items.claim: The repository reports 15 of 30 daily collections, a complete baseline, a consistent reported harness hash and pinned CLI, and no post-baseline comparison result.

items.title: LiveNerf records its cutoff correction
items.claim: The maintainer records a 3 October correction aligning the baseline cutoff to 4 October 00:00 UTC and says a regression test covers a late first run. No post-baseline comparison result was published at this check.

items.title: Current analysis code could not be verified
items.claim: The available browser-rendered code page was crawled six days before this check and showed the older cutoff function; it is not current enough to establish the code now on the default branch.

items.title: Opus 5.5 issue comments describe different client and prompt histories
items.claim: The original issue reports a token-use shift with CLI version changed and unmatched sessions. Later comments report higher token means alongside a server-delivered prompt section on constant CLI, and a perceived quality/tool-use shift on constant CLI with unchanged prompt snapshots. These are self-reports, not a controlled task-quality comparison or provider-confirmed change.

items.title: Anthropic marked Opus 5.5 request errors resolved
items.claim: Anthropic investigated elevated Opus 5.5 request errors at 12:24 UTC and marked the incident resolved at 12:43 UTC on 6 October. It listed claude.ai, the API, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork as affected. This is an availability record, not a quality result.

items.title: Incorrect organization spend-limit pauses resolved
items.claim: Anthropic says some organizations were incorrectly paused, causing refused requests on Claude services and API; the incident was marked resolved at 21:23 UTC on 7 October. This is an access record, not a completed-answer quality result.

items.title: Sampled Opus 5.5 Reddit opinion index is stable week over week
items.claim: As of 11:55 UTC on 9 October, ModelSentiment reported an index of 66 from 1,974 opinions in 799 threads for the latest 7-day window, unchanged from the previous window. Its data are a Reddit sample and measure opinion, not model capability.

items.title: One coding report describes the cost of repeated corrections
items.claim: One user describes a coding task that followed an unrelated API path despite correction and reports costs in time, tokens, and context. The account has no before/after baseline, independent reproduction, or verified served-model receipt.

items.title: LiveNerf still has no post-baseline comparison
items.claim: The latest README remains dated 8 October and reports 15/30 collections, a completed baseline, and no post-baseline comparison. A missing comparison is not a result of no change.
